motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential deceleration curve (--sc-ease-out, --aw-ease) for button states, tab border shifts, and flow reveals.

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Color and border transition duration on host buttons/links (120ms inside studio; 110ms active scale).

motion.name: pointer-damping
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer damping on Acts 1, 3, and 4 forwarded via zero-DOM-touch setPointer/setProgress hooks; shader smooths uniforms at 1 - exp(-dt * 10.0).

motion.name: peak-dwell
motion.purpose: Cubic Scroll-Craft dwell factor on Act 4 (#act-artifact, pin[3.6]) holding the liquid-mercury cleavage phase mid-pin.

motion.name: webgl-budget
motion.value: MAX_DPR 2.5 (3840x2400 cap) / single-pass Sobel PBR (3-5 taps) / staggered uploads / offscreen paused
motion.purpose: Single WebGL context lazy-initialized at 1100px + requestIdleCallback + KHR_parallel_shader_compile with 1-per-frame texImage2D uploads, 2.5x HiDPI backing resolution with 5-frame adaptive governor, static paused redraws on scroll/resize, 3-plate CSS cross-fade fallback, and rAF pausing on IntersectionObserver exit, document.hidden, contentvisibilityautostatechange, and WCAG 2.2.2 Pause shader.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Zeroes transforms, enables native horizontal scroll on Act 2 rail, and holds the crisp static artifact-poster.webp with zero WebGL context spin-up.

breakpoints.name: compact-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Verified zero-overflow compact viewport floor (360x640, 11940px doc height).

breakpoints.name: studio-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Collapses Refractory Starter Kit grid and Lexicon/Wiki/Soul grid to 1 column; narrows studio padding and map height.

breakpoints.name: mobile-cleave
breakpoints.purpose: Hides top nav anchor links, stacks Act 1 split hero vertically, narrows corridor plates to min(88vw, 336px), stacks Peak artifacts.

breakpoints.name: tablet-cleave
breakpoints.purpose: Adjusts Act 1 split ratio to 54fr 46fr and collapses 30-Day Ledger week rows to single column.

breakpoints.name: desktop-studio
breakpoints.purpose: Switches Refractory workspace to 0.9fr / 1.35fr split pane and wraps 30-day selector buttons without scrollbar.

narrative.overview: Aether WebOS Kit v2.4 turns unstructured plain-English notes into Wave 0 to Wave 2 floorplans through freeze-frame meteorite cleavage, concentric sculpted phone-widget geometry, and perceptual mineral contrast. Built by Eloquent (@mjeanhudson-dev), the page opens under a floating 999px capsule dock on a full-bleed pre-impact bolide stage (T - 0.04s) that detonates on click into an organically fractured Widmanstatten caldera and Smart AI Quote Router, pans a six-plate 25-turn amnesia autopsy, drops into basalt-and-obsidian mirror-void silence, awakens a 2.5x HiDPI single-pass Sobel PBR WebGL image-relighting Peak over three macro mineral plates, hydrates a concentric sculpted Operate studio with rounded bezier SVG mind-maps and live native spellcheck, and connects directly to a zero-login Wave 0..2 Smart Quote Synthesizer at eloquent@eloquentwin.com.
keyCharacteristics: Concentric sculpted phone-widget radii (28px shell, 20px-26px cards, 18px dossier widgets, 14px SVG rx=14 mind-map nodes with cubic-bezier curves, 12px controls, 999px capsule dock and pills) paired with scoped [data-aw-surface="obsidian"|"paper"] Operate surfaces.

Perceptual mineral contrast (>= 4.5:1 WCAG AA across Obsidian and Paper: Molten Troilite Amber, Burnished Champagne-Titanium, Mineral Celadon-Jade, Terracotta Cinnabar) with zero 0px/2px sharp cages and zero [data-sc-progress] spoiler bars.

Single-pass Sobel PBR WebGL image-relighting Peak (./webgl/artifact-shader.js, MAX_DPR = 2.5 up to 3840x2400, per-plate aspect correction, staggered uploads, static paused redraws, 3-plate CSS cross-fade fallback) paused offscreen with Pause shader (WCAG 2.2.2).
Self-hosted WOFF2 fonts (./fonts/*.woff2, 103.0 KB total) and 9 HiDPI/4K macro geological WebP plates (2.99 MB total) with ./assets/*.webp.json provenance sidecars, zero external requests.

rules.name: The Cleaved Polarity Rule
rules.body: Pair Warm Alabaster (#F2EFE8, #111214) directly against Obsidian (#07090D, #ECEAE4, #A8B0BC) along 1px seams rather than blending mid-grays.

rules.name: The Molten Troilite Reserve Rule
rules.body: Restrict #E27A2C strictly to primary actions, active landmarks, and mineral glints; pair solid fills with #111214 ink and shift inline amber text to #EA8D44 (obsidian) or #984306 (paper).

rules.name: The Scoped Dual-Surface Rule
rules.body: Confine [data-aw-surface="obsidian"|"paper"] toggling to #aether-webos-mount so narrative acts hold fixed lighting.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Self-Hosted Rule
rules.body: Serve only self-hosted BricolageGrotesque (preloaded) and RedHatMono WOFF2 fonts from ./fonts/ with font-synthesis-weight: none; never add third-party font stylesheets or unnecessary above-fold preload stalls.

rules.name: The Monospace Measurement Rule
rules.body: Reserve RedHatMono (tabular-nums) for digests, day indices, coordinates, and Markdown/capsule text editors rather than decorative prose.

rules.name: The Surprise-Over-Spoiler Rule
rules.body: Omit [data-sc-progress] top bars so horizontal travel, Mirror Void silence, and Peak cleavage land without progress spoilers.

rules.name: The Budgeted Single-Peak Rule
rules.body: Permit one active WebGL context (./webgl/artifact-shader.js) capped at 1.25 DPR with staggered texture uploads, static paused redraws, and 3-plate CSS fallback, pausing requestAnimationFrame offscreen, when hidden, or under content-visibility: auto, paired with Pause shader (WCAG 2.2.2).

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Never add drop shadows or blurred glass; convey elevation exclusively via stepped tonal fills and 1px hairline partitions.

rules.name: The Concentric Sculpted Widget Rule
rules.body: Shape outer shells at 28px (26px on large stage cards), bento/pane cards at 20px-24px, dossier/preview panels at 16px-18px, controls and SVG rx=14 mind-map nodes at 12px-14px, and floating docks/CTAs/chips/tabs at 999px, replacing legacy 0px/2px sharp boxes and 1px spreadsheet cages.

rules.name: The Sculpted Operate Dossier Rule
rules.body: Partition #act-studio, #act-contact, and #act-curriculum with breathable 0.75rem-1.5rem card gaps, perceptual mineral contrast, and top specular highlights rather than 1px spreadsheet cell dividers.

dos: Do pair #E27A2C fills strictly with #111214 ink, and shift inline amber text to #F08A38 (obsidian) or #964205 (paper) for >= 4.5:1 AA contrast.
Do keep Paper/Obsidian toggling scoped to #aether-webos-mount via [data-aw-surface="obsidian"|"paper"].
Do retain content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size and explicit width/height on WebP assets to hold CLS 0.00.
Do wire Pause shader (WCAG 2.2.2), prefers-reduced-motion static fallbacks, and offscreen/hidden rAF pausing on WebGL stages.
Do avoid em/en dashes across copy and docs, and cite only ./ or ~/ paths under Eloquent (@mjeanhudson-dev).
donts: Don't add [data-sc-progress] bars, 01 / 06 section counters, 0px/2px sharp button boxes, 1px spreadsheet divider cages, or stock #67CEFA/#4ADE80/#F87171 colors.
Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headings, synthetic weights outside 400/700, or remote font CDN links.
Don't run multiple WebGL contexts or leave requestAnimationFrame active offscreen or under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Don't mask mineral cutouts with CSS clip-path geometry instead of true RGBA alpha mattes.
Don't edit ./scrollcraft.js or ./scrollcraft.css, leak local OS usernames or personal Gmail literals, or fabricate user quotes or metrics.
